value.note: Anti-vacuity self-test: the intermediate library compile (stage A) must itself carry an RDAT part. DxilContainerAssembler.cpp only ever writes RDAT inside the pSM->IsLib() branch, so a library-profile compile is required to emit it; if this clause fails the reader or the compiler is broken, not the subject of the issue -- see #5703 expected.md.

The reported symptom (#5703): after IDxcLinker::Link(...) to a concrete profile (cs_6_3), the resulting container has no RDAT part. Matches when the linked container's part table (parsed directly from DxilContainerHeader/DxilPartHeader per include/dxc/DxilContainer/DxilContainer.h) contains no FourCC 'RDAT'.
